label: Not authorized
definition: The outlet type cannot sell the beverage anywhere in the state under its ordinary license.

label: Authorized
definition: State law lets the outlet type be licensed to sell the beverage. Localities may still prohibit sales under a general local-option law (see local_prohibition_option).

label: Authorized only where localities opt in
definition: State law permits the outlet type to sell the beverage only in localities that adopt it for this channel (for example by referendum). Take-up is a separate, local dimension.

label: Only through a special channel
definition: Sales happen only through a special arrangement, such as a state-contract agency or a separately licensed area inside the store, not under the outlet's ordinary license.

label: Barred for chain stores and supermarkets
definition: State law bars chain stores and supermarkets of the outlet type from the ordinary license (licenses already held may be exempt); other stores of the type may be licensed. Local rules may differ.

label: Permitted
definition: Package stores may sell beer.

label: Not permitted
definition: Package stores may not sell beer.

label: Permitted
definition: State law allows it.

label: Not permitted
definition: State law does not allow it.

label: Available
definition: The channel exists under state law.

label: Not available
definition: The channel does not exist under state law.

label: State-operated stores
definition: Off-premises sales of the beverage are made by stores the state itself runs.

label: State stores and state-contract agencies
definition: The state runs stores and also contracts private businesses to sell on its behalf.

label: State-contract agencies only
definition: Sales are made by private businesses under contract with the state; the state runs no stores.

label: Local-government stores
definition: Off-premises sales are made by stores run by local governments or local boards (for example county boards).

label: Private licensed retailers
definition: Private businesses licensed by the state sell the beverage.

label: Mixed state and private
definition: Both state-run (or state-contract) and private licensed retailers sell the beverage.

label: Mixed local-government and private
definition: Stores run by local governments (for example municipal liquor stores) and private licensed retailers both sell the beverage; the state runs no stores.

label: State is the wholesaler
definition: The state buys from suppliers and wholesales the beverage itself.

label: Private licensed wholesalers
definition: Private wholesalers licensed by the state distribute the beverage.

label: Mixed
definition: Both the state and private wholesalers distribute the beverage (for example by product or strength class).

label: No sales below cost plus 20%
definition: Retail wine may not be sold below the retailer's cost plus 20 percent.

label: No minimum price rule
definition: State law sets no floor on retail wine prices.

label: Allowed
definition: Off-premises sales of the beverage are allowed on Sunday statewide (hours may be restricted).

label: Prohibited
definition: Off-premises sales of the beverage are prohibited on Sunday statewide.

label: Local option
definition: State law lets localities decide whether Sunday off-premises sales are allowed.

label: Allowed
definition: The practice is allowed under state law (conditions may apply).

label: Prohibited
definition: The practice is prohibited under state law.

label: Allowed with significant conditions
definition: Allowed only under conditions that limit it materially (for example only some license types, or volume caps).
